EXPLANATION: The very strong 920 cm⁻¹ band is characteristic of an N–O single-bond stretch found in oxime ethers, and the 1614 cm⁻¹ strong band fits a C=N (oxime) stretch. Candidate 3 uniquely contains the C=N–O motif. The strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2935/2880 cm⁻¹ match saturated groups (GFQ-003), and the 1064/1032/1007 cm⁻¹ cluster is consistent with C–O–C/CO stretches from the ether present in 3. The bands at 1466/1442/1399/1344 cm⁻¹ align with CH bending/deformation modes (GFQ-003). The 724 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with CH₂ rocking in aliphatic chains; the 654 cm⁻¹ feature can be attributed to skeletal deformations rather than a distinct functional group. Overall, the oxime ether plus ether functionalities in candidate 3 best rationalize the key Raman features.
